attchmntText: TAKE Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "TAKE Limited Reports Consolidated Total Income of ₹615.54 Million for the Half Year Ended September 2026; Advances Its Vision Across Digital Healthcare, AI and Longevity Sciences Through Innovation-Led Growth".
voiceSummary: TAKE Limited reported consolidated total income of 615.54 million rupees for the half year ended September 2026. The company recorded a consolidated profit after tax of 32.75 million rupees, compared to a loss of 12.13 million rupees in the previous year. Standalone total income was 280.52 million rupees with a net profit of 31.89 million rupees. For the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, consolidated net profit increased to 22.12 million rupees. The company announced the launch of TAKE.Health, a digital health platform. It also established a 50 million rupee innovation fund with an initial corpus of 5 crore rupees to support startups in artificial intelligence and digital health. TAKE Limited stated its strategic entry into the longevity and anti-ageing market.

attchmntText: TAKE Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: TAKE Limited reported unaudited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income was 615.54 million with a profit after tax of 32.75 million. Standalone total income was 280.52 million with a net profit of 31.89 million. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, consolidated total income was 298.52 million and net profit was 22.12 million. The board approved the financial results and a press release. The company launched TAKE.Health, an intelligent digital health companion. It also announced a 50 million innovation fund with an initial corpus of 5 crore. The company plans to enter the longevity and anti-ageing market. The board meeting was held on November 13, 2026.
